children: Bristol Myers Squibb said the FDA approved an expanded indication for CAMZYOS (mavacamten) to treat symptomatic obstructive HCM in adults and pediatric patients weighing ≥30 kg.
FDA OKs CAMZYOS pediatric use ≥30 kg
Expands the addressable market beyond adults, supporting longer-duration therapy and revenue potential.
Strengthens competitive position as the broadest CMI label, aiding share gains vs rivals.
Clinical validation underpins uptake; safety profile aligned with adults reduces adoption risk.
Program limits friction but adds monitoring burden; could temper rapid uptake.
Demonstrates existing demand; pediatric label can build on established prescriber base.

This is a late-stage regulatory expansion that builds on CAMZYOS’s established adult use and growing real-world adoption. A larger catalyst would require clear uptake data post-launch, payer coverage breadth, and any global pediatric approvals.
